name: Healthcare BPO

mofsl_2qfy27.headline: In-line performance; growth outlook remains constructive
mofsl_2qfy27.read: IKS grew organic USD revenue 13% YoY (industry ~12%) at a 27.7% EBITDA margin, ahead of estimates but diluted by TruBridge versus the legacy ~34.5-35%. Sagility grew 11.9% YoY organic in constant currency and its adjusted EBITDA margin reached 26.3%, a six-quarter high, prompting guidance of 25-26% for FY27 (from 24-25%). Indegene's INR revenue rose 39.5% YoY on acquisitions and Enterprise Commercial Solutions, with a ~16.5% margin and a target of 19%+ by 4QFY27; it signed nine USD1m+ ACV deals. MOFSL reiterates BUY on all three.

unit_economics: Revenue = billable FTEs (or transactions, or % of client collections) x rate, less 1-2% a year productivity give-back; EBITDA = revenue - offshore delivery cost (wage-led, INR-denominated) - technology; FX gains and hedge results sit either inside or below EBITDA depending on the company.

price_drivers.why: IKS 13% and Sagility 11.9% organic in 2Q against ~12% industry growth; multiples compress when organic growth drops to the market rate.
Global core-BPM lines shrank in 2026 and Sagility's stated give-back is rising from ~1-1.5% to ~2%; stocks de-rated from 30x toward 17-20x P/E on this fear.
Sagility 26.3% and IKS 27.7% (TruBridge dilution) both include or sit near FX benefits; Indegene's 16.5% shows the miss risk against a 19%+ target.
Sagility top-10 is ~84% of revenue; IKS quarterly top-5 near 42%; a 20% cut at one client is the standard stress test.
Indegene's 39.5% growth is mostly acquired; TruBridge integration (return to growth from FY28) and BioPharm earn-outs decide quality of growth.

kpis.name: Organic constant-currency revenue growth
kpis.definition: USD revenue growth excluding acquired revenue for the first 12 months and FX.
kpis.formula: Reported CC growth - acquired revenue / base revenue
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Growth against the ~12% industry rate is the premium justification: IKS 13% and Sagility 11.9% sustain 17-25x multiples, and Indegene's headline 39.5% is acquisition-led.
kpis.history_source: get_investor_presentation metric filter 'constant currency' / 'organic' (SAGILITY, FSL, ECLERX, INDGN); get_financials for USD revenue; transcripts (organic is call-only at IKS and Firstsource).
kpis.estimate_source: No consensus field; get_consensus_estimates Bloomberg Sales only; guidance from transcripts (Sagility low-double-digit organic FY27; Indegene FY27 above FY26).
kpis.traps: Firstsource guides CC including acquisitions (organic ~9.8% vs 13.6% headline); IKS TruBridge consolidated from 10-Jul-2026 and its run-rate was reset; Indegene stopped the ex-BioPharm split.

kpis.name: House EBITDA margin (ex FX, ex other income)
kpis.definition: Income from services less operating cost, excluding FX gains, hedge results and treasury, shown beside the company figure.
kpis.formula: (Income from services - operating costs) / income from services
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Margin guidance changes move the stocks: Sagility raised to 25-26%, Indegene's band slipped from 22-24% to 19-20%; FX gains were ~2pp of IKS FY26 company margin.
kpis.history_source: get_financials (revenue, employee cost, other expenses, other income, FX); get_investor_presentation metric filter 'EBITDA margin' / 'adjusted EBITDA'; MOFSL tables.
kpis.estimate_source: get_consensus_estimates Bloomberg EBITDA / Sales for the implied margin; company margin guidance in transcripts (IKS FY30 EBITDA ~INR30b aspiration).
kpis.traps: Sagility redefined adjusted EBITDA in Q1FY26; IKS company EBITDA includes FX and contingent-consideration gains; eClerx's band includes other income; hedge results booked in revenue at Firstsource, eClerx and IKS.

kpis.name: Top-client share and top-client growth
kpis.definition: Share of revenue from top-1/5/10 clients and their growth against the rest.
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Sagility's top-3 grew 9.1% a year versus 16.2% for the company, and IKS top-5 revenue grew 60% YoY in 1QFY27; either too slow or too fast signals a mining or concentration problem and drives stress-test discounts.
kpis.history_source: get_investor_presentation metric filter 'top client' / 'top 5' / 'top 10' / 'client buckets'; annual reports for Ind AS 108 major-customer notes (read_library_document).
kpis.estimate_source: No consensus field; No forward estimate; assessed via stress test (cut largest client 20%).
kpis.traps: Quarterly vs annual concentration bases differ at IKS; Sagility counts client groups; Firstsource dropped top-client share after Q4FY24.

kpis.name: Stated price give-back and non-FTE revenue share
kpis.definition: Management-stated productivity give-back per year and the disclosed share of outcome, PMPM or %-of-collections revenue.
kpis.formula: Stated % or (volume growth - revenue growth) residual
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Sagility moved its give-back from 1.5-2% to 'could go to 200bp'; any outcome-pricing claim without a disclosed share is narrative and does not protect against AI deflation.
kpis.history_source: Transcripts via search_research (filter 'deflation', 'pricing'); get_investor_presentation for contingent revenue; annual reports for contract-price notes.
kpis.estimate_source: No consensus field; Management commentary in transcripts; Kotak and Nuvama sector notes in the library.
kpis.traps: Only Sagility quantifies it; Firstsource 'about half non-linear' is undefined; IKS gives no number.

kpis.name: ACV, large deals and bookings conversion
kpis.definition: Annual contract value of wins and large deals against trailing revenue.
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Indegene signed nine USD1m+ ACV deals including one USD5m+ and Sagility cited a payment-integrity deal with ACV above USD10m; conversion to revenue timing sets next-4-quarter growth.
kpis.history_source: get_investor_presentation metric filter 'ACV' / 'large deals' / 'wins' (SAGILITY, INDGN, ECLERX); transcripts.
kpis.estimate_source: No consensus field; Company deal pipeline language in transcripts.
kpis.traps: Sagility ACV is 'potential steady-state'; Firstsource and IKS never disclose ACV; wins counted gross, not net new.

kpis.name: Headcount, attrition and revenue per employee
kpis.definition: Average headcount, net adds, attrition and USD revenue per average employee.
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Revenue growing faster than headcount (Firstsource FY26 revenue +14.6% vs headcount +4.5%) shows AI-led productivity or outcome pricing; the same gap can mean FTE work leaving.
kpis.history_source: get_investor_presentation metric filter 'headcount' / 'attrition'; get_financials employee cost.
kpis.traps: Attrition has no common basis; Indegene headcount includes contractors; archetypes are not comparable.

kpis.name: FX gain, hedge book and INR sensitivity
kpis.definition: Hedge book, hedge rate versus spot, hedge gain or loss and where it is booked.
kpis.why_it_moves_price: INR depreciation funds wage hikes and price cuts, but hedge books convert gains into lagged losses; derivative liabilities of INR1.8bn (Sagility), INR4.6bn (Firstsource) and INR1.6bn (eClerx) were carried at Mar-26.
kpis.history_source: Annual reports and financials notes (get_financials; read_library_document); transcripts for hedge commentary.
kpis.estimate_source: No consensus field; Management commentary only.
kpis.traps: Hedge results sit inside revenue at Firstsource/eClerx/IKS but in other income at Sagility; Indegene hedge MTM ran through P&L until Jan-2026.

kpis.name: Cash conversion and client upfront payments
kpis.definition: Operating cash flow after tax over house EBITDA, before and after client advances; DSO including unbilled.
kpis.formula: OCF after tax / house EBITDA; (billed + unbilled receivables) / revenue x days
kpis.why_it_moves_price: IKS's advances of ~13% of revenue to win platform deals depress cash conversion (FY26 company OCF/EBITDA 62% after payments); falling conversion precedes de-rating.
kpis.history_source: get_financials cash flow and balance sheet; annual reports for contract assets and deferred contract costs.
kpis.traps: Indegene's net DSO deducts unearned revenue; factoring flatters Firstsource DSO.

valuation_anchor: P/E on 2-year-forward house-normalised EPS ex net cash, against own regime band (AI de-rating regime from Feb-2026: street targets ~15-25x, IKS ~25-34x); EV/EBITDA after leases as cross-check; IKS services and EHR book valued separately.
watch_next_quarter: Per MOFSL, track IKS TruBridge synergies from 2HFY27 and cross-sell, Sagility's raised 25-26% margin and the USD10m+ payment-integrity deal, and Indegene's path to 19%+ margin by 4QFY27 with 2HFY27 growth above 1H.
